summary: Add observable mechanism-cost evidence, execution-window telemetry capture, and quality-gated selective ablation so resource-heavy ICM components can be optimized empirically without private reasoning or automatic removal.

candidates.rationale: Reuse Developer Observatory and Evaluation Arena rather than introduce another always-on optimizer; cost evidence proposes ablation candidates while controlled quality evidence is required before removal review.

applied_changes.description: Added cross-session mechanism cost profiles/candidates, window-scoped CLI capture, stored-event round-trip support, Arena ablation comparison, CLI surfaces, documentation, and regressions.
